# PaceBowl Studio (https://pacebowl.com)

> Production-grade, zero-friction, 100% client-side micro-utilities engineered for modern AI workflows, prompters, and developers. No login, no server queues, zero telemetry bloat.

## Machine-Readable Resources
- [Agent Skills Index](https://pacebowl.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Machine-executable skill schemas and endpoints for autonomous agents.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Spec](https://pacebowl.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical specifications, resolution tables, and prompt presets.
- [Canonical Sitemap](https://pacebowl.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap index for search crawlers and generative agents.

## Core Tool Matrix & Direct Applications
- [PaceBowl Studio Hub](https://pacebowl.com/): Central portal and mothership showcase for the PaceBowl client-side micro-utility matrix.
- [Cursor Rules Generator](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/): Configure and export modular .cursor/rules/*.mdc files, Claude Code CLAUDE.md, and Windsurf rules.
- [ComfyUI Prompt & Latent Studio](https://comfy.pacebowl.com/): Trained 1MP Empty Latent calculator and Flux.1 natural language prompt builder for ComfyUI.
- [OpenGEO Attribution Studio](https://geo.pacebowl.com/): Cookie-free AI search referral analytics and Stripe revenue conversion attribution engine.
- [DeepSeek Prompt Generator](https://deepseek.pacebowl.com/): Zero-latency prompt engineering studio for DeepSeek-R1 & V3 with 277+ agency personas.
- [MoE VRAM & Hardware Estimator](https://moe.pacebowl.com/): True VRAM calculator, KV cache scaling, and cluster topology calculator for MoE LLMs.
- [Reddit Growth Studio](https://reddit.pacebowl.com/): 15-word viral one-liner engine and AutoMod risk radar for developer audience growth.

## Key Technical Specifications & Standards
- Architecture: 100% Client-Side Web Applications, Zero Server Queues, Zero GPU Overhead, $0 Cost.
- Empty Latent Resolutions: 1024x1024 (1:1), 1344x768 (16:9), 768x1344 (9:16), 1152x896 (4:3), 896x1152 (3:4), 1536x640 (21:9).
- Cursor Rules Format: Frontmatter with description, globs matching, and alwaysApply flags to prevent LLM context saturation (~75% token savings).

## Technical Runbooks & Knowledge Base
- [Cursor Rules (.mdc) vs .cursorrules Migration Guide](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/blog/cursor-rules-mdc-vs-cursorrules.html): Architectural comparison and step-by-step upgrade path.
- [How to Write Next.js 15 Cursor Rules](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/blog/how-to-write-nextjs-15-cursor-rules.html): Production rules for App Router and React 19 Server Actions.
- [ComfyUI Empty Latent Resolution Guide](https://comfy.pacebowl.com/blog/comfyui-empty-latent-resolution-guide.html): Mathematical deep dive into 1MP bucketing and VAE 64 alignment.
- [Flux.1 Prompting Guide: Mastering T5 Natural Language](https://comfy.pacebowl.com/blog/flux-prompting-guide-t5-natural-language.html): Complete guide to descriptive prose prompting for Flux.1 models.
